boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Louisville
boards.description: Current late-hour food stops in Louisville, with published hours checked on August 13, 2026.

cards.title: Burger Boy Diner
cards.subtitle: 1450 South Brook Street, Old Louisville
cards.notes: Head to the Old Louisville diner when you need food outside ordinary dinner hours; confirm any holiday changes before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 diner near the University of Louisville campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Burger Boy Diner says it is open 24/7 and located in Old Louisville near the University of Louisville.
cards.access_notes: The business website states: open 24/7. Check directly for exceptions.

cards.title: Denny's on Eastern Parkway
cards.subtitle: 434 Eastern Parkway, Louisville
cards.notes: Use the published round-the-clock restaurant option for a seated meal or takeout, and check the location page before departure.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours Denny's location with breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its 434 Eastern Parkway restaurant as open 24 hours and offering round-the-clock breakfast, lunch, dinner, and takeout.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists every day as open 24 hours; it also lists walk-ins and takeout.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Preston Highway
cards.subtitle: 2508 Preston Highway, Louisville
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery from this Preston Highway location when a late pizza option fits the plan; verify delivery coverage first.
cards.short_summary: Pizza Hut with nightly late carryout hours and later Friday–Saturday closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists this Louisville location's carryout hours through 1 a.m. daily and through 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published carryout hours: 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy's on Taylor Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 3422 Taylor Road, Louisville
cards.notes: Use the restaurant or drive-thru for a late meal, and rely on the location page rather than general chain hours for updates.
cards.short_summary: A Louisville Wendy's listing restaurant and drive-thru service until 2:30 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists its Taylor Blvd location's restaurant and drive-thru hours as 8 a.m.–2:30 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows restaurant and drive-thru open until 2:30 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Beulah Church Road
cards.subtitle: 6701 Beulah Church Road, Louisville
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru service if traveling this direction late; the published dining-room hours end earlier than the drive-thru hours.
cards.short_summary: A Taco Bell whose drive-thru is listed until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 6701 Beulah Church Rd drive-thru as open 10 a.m.–3 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. daily; Sunday dine-in is listed only until 10 p.m.

cards.title: McDonald's on East Market Street
cards.subtitle: 420 East Market Street, downtown Louisville
cards.notes: Use the restaurant or drive-thru for an all-hours option downtown; check the official location page for menu availability and service changes.
cards.short_summary: A downtown McDonald's listing both lobby and drive-thru as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists its 420 E Market St location's restaurant/lobby and drive-thru as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists lobby and drive-thru as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: IHOP on South Hurstbourne Parkway
cards.subtitle: 1401 South Hurstbourne Parkway, Louisville
cards.notes: Choose this location for a sit-down meal or takeout at any hour, then confirm transportation and any holiday service changes before going.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour IHOP with dine-in, takeout, curbside pickup, and delivery listed.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 1401 S. Hurstbourne Pkwy location as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page says the restaurant is open 24 hours and lists dine-in, takeout, pickup, and delivery.

cards.title: Taqueria Santa Rosa Restaurante
cards.subtitle: 501 W Evelyn Avenue, Louisville
cards.notes: Check the restaurant's own page before a late visit, especially on Friday or Saturday when its listed schedule differs from other days.
cards.short_summary: A Louisville taqueria whose official site lists 24-hour Sunday–Thursday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taqueria Santa Rosa Restaurante lists Sunday through Thursday as open 24 hours at 501 W Evelyn Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Sunday–Thursday as open 24 hours; Friday and Saturday are listed as 9 a.m.–10 a.m.

cards.title: Four Brothers Food Mart
cards.subtitle: 3283 Taylor Boulevard, Louisville
cards.notes: Use the 24-hour store for snacks, groceries, or its Hunt Brothers Pizza offering; confirm prepared-food availability directly if timing matters.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 convenience store with snacks, groceries, and Hunt Brothers Pizza.
cards.evidence_claim: Four Brothers Food Mart says it is open 24 hours, seven days a week and offers snacks, groceries, and Hunt Brothers Pizza.
cards.access_notes: Business website states it is open 24/7 and describes pizza, snacks, drinks, and groceries; prepared-food timing may vary.

cards.title: Wendy's on Mud Lane
cards.subtitle: 5036 Mud Lane, Louisville
cards.notes: Use this location's late restaurant or drive-thru service when traveling near Mud Lane; verify its location-specific holiday schedule before going.
cards.short_summary: A Wendy's location listing restaurant and drive-thru service until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists its Mud Lane restaurant and drive-thru as open until 2 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows restaurant and drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.
